title: EC384 test cert: notBefore > notAfter (already expired)
description: EC384_CERT_HEX in smime_tests.rs has notBefore=2026-05-02 and notAfter=2026-04-29 — notBefore is 3 days AFTER notAfter. The cert is structurally invalid and already expired. Any test that calls validate_chain() or check_validity() with this cert will fail. Current encrypt-only tests (I, J) pass only because openssl cms -decrypt does not check cert validity. Adding an EC384 signing/verify test would silently fail cert chain validation with CertificateExpired.
close_reason: Fixed: EC384 cert regenerated with valid dates (notBefore < notAfter); KARI P-256 oracle test added with Python-generated fixture verified by OpenSSL decrypt
